signal_selection: Reconstruct first qualifying same-construction 3-observation signal; deterministic highest entry edge then persistence key tie break; no outcome columns admitted. No new rule search.
execution: Lock original digital/token,quantity-per-spread,CME route/direction and months. Use only source observations <= execution time and <=60s old, PM observation timestamp > signal. CME event and receive clocks both checked. No edge requalification and no retry after missing delayed quote.
reserve_label: Illustrative fixed cash reserve, not verified historical broker margin; gross positions, no offsets
size: Integer repeat packages. Floor min(event budget, current free cash minus cash buffer) divided by package purchase costs plus reserve; clamp to locked-route purchase-side CME top-of-book size. Q per package unchanged.
fees_label: Declared cost scenario, not historical invoice reconstruction
funding: Self-funded account; no invented borrowing expense. Separate 5% ACT/365 opportunity-cost metric on digital cash until proxy payout and reserve until release. No idle-cash interest.
pm_payout_clock: Target FOMC date +2 US federal-holiday business days at 17:00 ET, explicit proxy. Winner used only at payout.
futures_daily_marks: Process available final-version daily records no earlier than ts_recv and next US federal-holiday business day at 09:00 ET. Older trade_date cannot replace newer mark. Month final uses independent rounded EFFR only after proxy release. Late/missing marks logged, daily-path model not intraday broker margin validation.
futures_final_clock: Each delivery month end +7 calendar days rolled forward to US federal-holiday business day at 17:00 ET, explicit proxy; close each leg separately. Reserve released only after both legs final.
missing: Keep NOT_EVALUABLE,NO_SIGNAL,NO_FILL_DATA,NO_FILL_CAPITAL,PENDING,CLOSED distinct. Missing execution has no modeled order, not zero opportunity or a losing trade; pending PnL never filled with zero.
metrics: median closed trade PnL / initial 100000 (account contribution)
median closed trade PnL / allocated initial cash incl reserve
median closed trade PnL / digital cash costs excl reserve
daily cash/reserve, capital rejects and funding breaches; incomplete final NAV remains NA
depth: CME visible size bounds conditional fill only. No PM historical bid/ask size: cannot certify any scaled fill. Strict verified-fill median NA, not zero.
overfit: Historical sample inspected previously. Fixed-rule causal replay, not untouched OOS or zero-overfitting certification. No parameter winner selected.
snapshot_note: Inspection snapshot: source paths adapted for external private inputs. Frozen model parameters retained. Original input hashes retained as provenance; not a claim that private inputs are bundled.
